comment: Every external part Lullaby is made of, tries or watches, with the version it is pinned to and how to look for a newer one. release/check-components.py reads this file; `make componentcheck` checks it offline. A pin moves only in a commit that says why. Sections: ship = reaches players, try = tried here and not shipped, watch = followed for ideas or for the future.

components.name: Dormison (the Wine engine)
components.policy: r8 is out but its tarball ships Apple's D3DMetal files and fails engine-manifest.json (agent/bugs/dormison-r8-staged-gptk); stay on r7, read the new release before moving; the bridge is rebuilt per engine commit.

components.name: Wine + wine-staging inside Dormison
components.policy: comes with the engine; shown to see how far behind the engine is.

components.name: DXMT (Direct3D 10/11 on Metal)
components.policy: comes with Dormison; a newer main commit was tried and refused (Deadlock black window), docs/DXMT_PIN.md.

components.name: DXVK for macOS
components.policy: comes with Dormison; the same line since 2023.

components.name: MoltenVK (Vulkan on Metal), the default Vulkan driver
components.policy: comes with Dormison r7 (driverInfo 1.4.0, read by a probe under Wine); changes with the engine, not on its own.

components.name: D3DMetal (Apple's Game Porting Toolkit)

check.note: Apple's page and the toolkit's Read Me: a new GPTK needs the ntdll/winemac patches ENG-04 to ENG-06 rechecked.

components.policy: not distributed; the player adds it.

components.name: Sparkle (app updates)
components.policy: a security fix is taken at once, otherwise with the next release.

components.name: Dobby (function hooks inside Steam)
components.policy: pinned on purpose: a newer commit changes the code generated for hooks (vendor/README.md); move only with a hook test on every supported Steam.

components.name: NVAPI headers (names for the Reflex answer)
components.policy: names and structures only; no code is taken.

components.name: mtld3d (Direct3D 9 on Metal)
components.policy: fetched by the run script the first time a game needs it, sha256 pinned; chosen by the scout for DX9; tried 2026-10-27 with a probe program (device created, 432 frames in 4 s) and no real D3D9 game yet.

components.name: WineMetalGL (OpenGL on Metal)
components.policy: fetched by the run script the first time a game needs it, sha256 pinned; chosen by the scout for OpenGL; tried 2026-10-27 with a probe program (OpenGL 4.6, 470 frames in 4 s) and no real OpenGL game yet; young project (releases a day apart).

components.name: KosmicKrisp (Mesa's Vulkan on Metal 4), built by us for x86_64
components.policy: the goal for native Vulkan games, MoltenVK until the five conditions at the end of docs/BACKLOG.md are met; watch for the fix of the vertex-shader subgroup bug (reports/mesa-issue-draft-kosmickrisp-vertex-subgroup) and rebuild with tools/build-kosmickrisp-local.sh.

components.name: LunarG Vulkan SDK for macOS (source of static SPIRV-Tools, reference KosmicKrisp)
components.policy: its own KosmicKrisp is arm64 only: useful once the engine's Wine is native arm64 (RULES section 7); sha256 of the pinned zip is in the build script.

components.name: athei/wine-build (native arm64 Wine, uses KosmicKrisp and mtld3d)
components.policy: candidate base for the native arm64 Wine; not evaluated yet.

components.name: Gcenx macOS Wine builds (what the DOOM 2016 launcher uses)
components.policy: reference for how others ship an x86_64 Wine with KosmicKrisp.

components.name: Highball engine (source of two engine fixes)
components.policy: ENG-01 and ENG-03 come from it.

components.name: Sevoflurane (shape of the settings catalog)
components.policy: catalog shape, env file format and help texts follow it (NOTICE).
